node.title: The multiplier lemma: a good c converts the mod-p relation into an EXACT integer relation
node.statement: For any c: if the reduced residues r_x = (c zeta^x mod+- p) satisfy sum over any support-(2l') ternary combo |sum v_x r_x| < p, then kernel membership forces the exact integer relation sum v_x r_x = 0. Elementary; the bridge from modular to integer arithmetic that every certificate below uses.
node.notes: True but VACUOUS at all relevant scales (Theorem 2: hypothesis unsatisfiable — zero good multipliers). Retained as scoping only. | FLIP on replay (Codex wave 5): PROVABLE -> PROVED.
